integrity: The elementary Green kernel, barrier comparison and algebraic certificates are described; the included script checks explicit formulas independently, with no claim of independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact closed forms apply to one-dimensional free Brownian diffusion with the nonsingular hazard a/(b+|x|)^2, not all inverse-square regularizations; renewal-count Fano limit assumes a/D>12. A related existing spatial moment hierarchy is credited, and an unindexed equivalent specialized clock calculation remains possible.
title: Exact renewal-clock moment thresholds and excess noise under inverse-square adaptive resetting
